desc: Read N and list A from stdin.
Implement two-pointer greedy: i = 0, j = 0, ans = 0; while i < N and j < N: ensure j > i; if A[i] * 2 <= A[j] then ans += 1, i += 1, j += 1; else j += 1.
Wrap in solve() and call it under if __name__ == "__main__":.
Test the solution on the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
